bullets.text: Minister R. Kumar attended the 18th India Game Developer Conference at the Chennai Trade Centre.
A young man named Maithreyan was hacked to death in Indira Nagar, Adyar, prompting swift police arrests of three suspects.

Leader MK Stalin condemned the daylight murder of a youth in Chennai and criticized the state administration.
A noted academic wrote to the state police chief alleging harassment by Tambaram city police over mistaken identity.
